title: DARPA's FAR exception and canceled stealth program

plain: John Blitch, who worked at DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, in the late 1990s, says he oversaw $130 million in projects, half of it robots and half a stealth programme that was cancelled about a month after it got going, "for no reason." He tells it from his own experience and says it matches what a General Trudeau told Philip J. Corso, an Army colonel who claimed he handed crash material to industry, to do, suggesting the cancellation was a cover for hidden work.
